decisions.reason: The module was launched only in 2023 and is merely mentioned on the website, so its results cannot yet be judged against the aspiration level, and a small electronics firm with modest slack keeps such a low-cost catalogue item while evidence accumulates.
A dedicated product page signals a strong commitment, and the module fits the firm's core industrial I/O business, so no performance shortfall triggers problemistic search in the first year.
A standard relay module adds to the existing I/O portfolio at low carrying cost, and one year is too soon to see a shortfall that would justify freeing its resources.

The server room kit lies somewhat further from the industrial core and faces more competition, which makes it more at risk, but it is too early for evidence of a shortfall against the aspiration level to force a drop.
